component.name: MiniOS Help
Справка MiniOS
component.summary: Просмотр документации MiniOS без подключения к сети

description.p: MiniOS Help is a native GTK 3 viewer for the documentation installed with MiniOS. It provides section navigation, local full-text search, language switching, link history and native Markdown rendering without a browser.
Documentation is read exclusively from the packaged local copy. The application does not download documentation or require a network connection.
